concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-google-pay-web-component-express-checkout]] — 2025-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Google Pay Web Component express guide for Advanced-only Web flow, v6 express flag, merchant-owned total validation and callback handoff; Android exclusion and inconsistent snippets are qualified in the source.
warnings: The base Google Pay Web Component page describes Sessions as a default path, but this express checkout guide explicitly requires Advanced flow.
Sample constructor, shipping-property and mount identifiers differ within the captured page; do not represent snippets as validated runnable code.
